description: This file defines an Angular service 'TbPopoverService' responsible for managing popover components, including creation, display, hiding, and toggling help popovers within the application. It handles interactions with popover components, manages their lifecycle, and integrates with Angular's dependency injection and component system.

classes.name: TbPopoverService
classes.description: Angular service for managing popover components, including creation, display, hiding, toggling, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: hasPopover
methods.description: Checks if a popover is currently associated with the given trigger element.

methods.name: hidePopover
methods.description: Hides the popover associated with the given trigger element if it is visible.

methods.name: createPopoverRef
methods.description: Creates a new popover component reference within a given view container.

methods.name: displayPopover
methods.description: Displays a popover based on provided configuration or parameters, handling different input types.

methods.name: displayPopoverWithComponentRef
methods.description: Displays a popover using a component reference and configuration, setting up event subscriptions and lifecycle.

methods.name: _displayPopoverWithComponentRef
methods.description: Internal method to finalize displaying a popover with a given configuration.

methods.name: toggleHelpPopover
methods.description: Toggles a help popover with specified content and styling, creating or hiding as needed.

methods.name: findPopoverByTrigger
methods.description: Finds the popover component associated with a specific trigger element.

methods.name: removePopoverByComponent
methods.description: Removes a popover from internal tracking by its component reference.

methods.name: elementsAreEqualOrDescendant
methods.description: Checks if two elements are equal or if one is a descendant of the other.
